summary: Every calculation opens with the project information table (the pile designs C011-C013 now carry the live stamp like the cap and backwall editions) and the modules are ordered with the calculations together in numerical order C001-C016 (registered component order; references, styles, includes and resources keep their slots). Presentation only: every formula and cache value unchanged.
published_outputs: PileDesignEndBentOne, PileDesignEndBentTwo, PileDesignPier: eight new result-only definitions each (Stamp_Firm ... Stamp_CheckDate = ProjectInfo.<Key>); all existing published names unchanged

Component order: index, ProjectInfo, Materials, BridgeGeometry_2Beam, AccessGeometry, PileProperties, PedBridgeWeights_2Beams, GeneralLoads, PedBridgeWind, LoadCombinations, FBMPPier, FBMPEndBent, FoundationModeling, C001 + references, C002 + references, C003 + references, C004 + references, C006, C007-C016, quantities, DecisionLog, Notes, CodeReferencesGeneral, archives
assumptions_and_conventions: The registered order (tools/bpad_workflow.py prepare --order) permutes modules among module slots only; the document shell and every component's bytes are preserved.
The index groups the calculations C001 to C016 in the same order, each reference packet after its calculation.
downstream_impact: pile_bpad/ rebuilt (standalone sheets with the static stamp; pile_bpad/journal/ with the live stamp); Pile_Design.ipynb rebuilt (embeds pile_design/bpad.py and scripts/bpad_sheet.py); PILE-TOOL re-registered.
